component.name: NexLauncher
component.summary: Run every project in your folder

description.p: NexLauncher finds the apps in your projects folder and runs them, with git, a terminal and AI agents built in.

ul.li: Detects projects from their manifests and runs frontends, backends, Flutter apps and Docker services
Git: stage, commit, pull, push, branches and history
Hand tasks to Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or Gemini CLI
Tasks per project and a terminal in every folder

description.p: NexLauncher comes to Linux, as a GNOME app.

ul.li: Run projects, read their logs, use git, a terminal and AI agents, as on the Mac
Dev servers, git and agents run on your system with your shell's PATH (nvm, pyenv, asdf)
Stop and quit stop everything NexLauncher started
